$comment: The rows of the dataset release at schema 2 (docs/v2.md), one JSON object per line of tengoku-dataset.jsonl.gz. Not the schema of data/ records (record.schema.json). A field that does not apply is left out, never null (headline: left out unless true). scripts/v2.py check enforces this file; the two are kept equal by scripts/tests/test_v2.py.

types.name: string
types.headline: boolean (true)
types.tree_module: string (a module of the tree: Tengoku.<...>)

row.ref: <library>:<name>, or <library>:<name>~<10 hex digits of the statement's sha256>, with .2, .3 ... when even that ties; unique in the dataset
row.legacy_name: a proper prefix of name: what schema 1 said where it cut the name
row.module: the Lean module of the .lean file source_url points into (the UPSTREAM module)
row.tree_module: the module of the Tengoku tree that holds the theorem (import it); present on the theorems that arrived as modules (data/intake)
row.via: how Gate 2 related the tree's statement to the upstream original's: equal (the same type) or entails (the tree's statement implies the original's, kernel-checked); present with tree_module when the factory recorded it
row.proof: the text from the := on; left out where the proof is a module of the tree (tree_module), and every row has one or the other
